file_stem: RWB E1 014 Decision log copy to the data lake
title: Decision log copy to the data lake
goal: Copy the decision log to the data lake nightly, matched on count and last hash, so reports avoid the live log
why: Reporting and audit need the full decision history without loading the production database. The copy is published only if it matches exactly.
triggers: RW-COE owns; RW-AUDIT reads the lake
ace_note: No ACE read. The source is the Workbench decision log, read only through the P7 DecisionLogExport interface.
stores: Data lake INT-19: decision-log/business_date=YYYY-MM-DD/ (Parquet + _manifest.json); archive tier for old partitions; Quartz
rules: BR1: zero-tolerance match on count and last hash, or the partition is not published
BR2: the log is read only through the P7 interface, never directly
BR4: partitions older than the retention rule move to the archive tier
BR6: a failed copy reruns the next night
risks: Count or hash mismatch -> not published, watermark kept (MSG-P1-019)
Export or lake down -> run Failed (MSG-GEN-006)
example: Live log: 12,480 entries, last hash a3f1...09c2
2026-11-30: 380 new entries -> partition business_date=2026-11-30 holds 380 rows
